title: FinEvo-Bench: A Longitudinal Benchmark for Self-Evolving Agents in Professional Financial Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2608.06144v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agents used over time encounter recurring professional work: each case requires different evidence and judgment, while the underlying workflow can be reused. Benchmarks built from independent tasks cannot reveal whether an agent turns earlier experience into better procedures for later cases. We introduce FinEvo-Bench, a longitudinal benchmark designed around this structure. It contains 120 open-ended tasks drawn from real cases across 20 business scenes in six financial domains. Each scene contains six substantively different cases that share a professional workflow and an expert-authored rubric for task quality and financial compliance. Constructing and validating the benchmark required approximately 1,200 person-hours. Finance provides a natural test bed because recurring analyses apply shared professional and compliance requirements to heterogeneous inputs, producing case-specific analyses and conclusions. translated_title: FinEvo-Bench：面向专业金融工作流程中自我进化智能体的纵向基准测试
translated_abstract: 长期使用的智能体会遇到重复出现的专业工作：每个案例需要不同的证据和判断，而底层工作流程是可以复用的。由独立任务构建的基准测试无法揭示智能体能否将早期经验转化为后续案例的更优流程。我们提出了FinEvo-Bench，一个围绕这一结构设计的纵向基准测试。它包含120个开放式任务，取自六个金融领域20个业务场景中的真实案例。每个场景包含六个实质上不同的案例，这些案例共享一个专业工作流程以及由专家撰写的、用于评估任务质量和金融合规性的评分标准。构建和验证该基准测试耗时约1200人时。金融领域提供了一个天然的测试平台，因为重复性的分析工作需要将共同的专业与合规要求应用于异构输入，并产出针对具体案例的分析与结论。我们评估了四个自……
tldr: FinEvo-Bench是一个纵向基准测试，通过六个金融领域20个业务场景中的120个真实开放式任务，评估自我进化智能体能否将先前经验转化为后续案例的更优工作流程。
en_tdlr: FinEvo-Bench is a longitudinal benchmark comprising 120 open-ended real-world tasks across 20 business scenes in six financial domains, designed to evaluate whether self-evolving agents can turn prior experience into better workflows for subsequent cases.
